assertion_results.assertion: Agent performed Dekart init check first using dekart call --name list_connections
assertion_results.evidence: After checking CLI availability, the agent ran list_connections before any query work, finding BigQuery/Snowflake/Wherobots connectors.
assertion_results.result_snippet: connections: BigQuery (id d23434e7-..., is_default true), Wherobots, Snowflake

assertion_results.assertion: Agent read BigQuery dialect refference from GeoSQL skill
assertion_results.evidence: Agent read references/bigquery.md from the skill base directory before drafting SQL, using its division_area and bbox-overlap patterns.
assertion_results.result_snippet: # BigQuery Reference ... Step 2: Resolve The Target Area ... division_area ... overlap pattern

assertion_results.assertion: Agent used bbox in SQL to optimize query cost
assertion_results.evidence: All discovery/validation/map queries used a Greater London bbox overlap gate (xmax>=-0.55, xmin<=0.35, ymax>=51.28, ymin<=51.70) for partition pruning.
assertion_results.result_snippet: AND bbox.xmax >= -0.55 AND bbox.xmin <= 0.35 AND bbox.ymax >= 51.28 AND bbox.ymin <= 51.70

assertion_results.assertion: Agent used dekart update_query to dry-run result
assertion_results.evidence: Every query was prepared via update_query, whose dry_run payload was read for cost/validity before run-query. Final map query dry-ran at 677MB valid.

assertion_results.assertion: Calculate the area of returned geometries and check if the total area is ~1,577 sq km (+/- 2%).
assertion_results.evidence: Re-ran SUM(ST_AREA(geometry))/1e6 over the 33 returned boroughs; total = 1577.4 km², within ±2% of 1577 (tolerance 1545.5–1608.5).
Final answer included the canonical report URL resolved via dekart report-url.

assertion_results.assertion: Agent verified map visually to confirm that all boroughs are present and the geometries look correct.
assertion_results.evidence: Agent rendered and inspected the snapshot PNG; it shows all 33 boroughs tiling Greater London with the Thames visible and no gaps/overlaps. Row count check confirmed 33 polygons.
assertion_results.result_snippet: Choropleth of 33 boroughs across full Greater London extent, Thames threading through, contiguous coverage
